notes: Second no-job-description case, frontend discipline. Exercises resume-only scoring for a UI-focused resume with no target JD. Resume band 70-84 is the thin-resume tier, below the other no-JD fixture: five skills and three bullets leave the no-JD keyword fallback well short of its ceiling. Job Match is not evaluated without a JD, so this fixture carries no match band.
